_doc: Voices by name for narration.json ("voices": {"narrator": "narrator"}). These are PREMADE public ElevenLabs voices, available to every account. To use your own voices, copy this file to audio/voices.json (git-ignored) and edit it, or point --voices-file / MATHSCENES_VOICES at another file. List the voices your key can use: python audio/narrate.py --list-voices
